title: Day 778: Gunmen Open Fire on Fleeing Victim in Lomas del Boulevard, Culiacán
detail: Around 2:30 PM on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, armed subjects opened fire on an unidentified person at the corner of Boulevard Manuel J. Clouthier and the Rolando Arjona bridge, in the Lomas del Boulevard neighborhood of Culiacán. The target fled the scene on foot and escaped the attack. Mexican Army personnel responding to the scene recovered at least nine spent shell casings from a small-caliber firearm, and two vehicles — including a company pickup truck — were struck by gunfire. The area was cordoned off while state investigative police and forensic experts processed evidence; no arrests were announced. The attack was part of a broader wave of violence reported across Culiacán that day, including vehicle fires, thefts and at least one killing in other sectors of the city.
